name: autogluon.tabular
description: AutoGluon Tabular automates ML model training for tabular data, excelling at numerical and categorical data processing. It doesn't support NLP or image-based tasks.
prompt_template: Do not use presets or optional model families unless the runtime instructions explicitly allow them.
Normalize AutoGluon leaderboard() output before saving project artifacts: persist exact fields model and validation_score, and rename timing columns such as pred_time_val to pred_time when available.
Use predictor.model_best or the top normalized leaderboard row to identify the selected model.
